description: Fundamentals of photography including exposure, composition, and equipment

aperture.definition: Size of lens opening; measured in f-stops
aperture.relationship: Lower f-number = larger opening = more light = shallower depth of field
aperture.depth_of_field: f/1.4 → blurred background (portrait); f/16 → everything sharp (landscape)

shutter_speed.definition: How long camera sensor is exposed to light
shutter_speed.slow: Blur motion; panning shots; long exposure night photography; tripod needed below 1/60

iso.low_iso: 100–400; clean image; use in good light
iso.high_iso: 1600+; more noise/grain; needed in low light

exposure_triangle.relationship: Changing one element requires adjusting others to maintain correct exposure

composition_rules.rule_of_thirds: Divide frame into 3×3 grid; place subjects at intersections
composition_rules.leading_lines: Use natural lines to draw eye toward subject (roads, fences, rivers)
composition_rules.framing: Use elements to frame the main subject (arches, doorways, tree branches)
composition_rules.symmetry: Perfect symmetry for powerful, formal compositions
composition_rules.negative_space: Empty space around subject; creates breathing room
composition_rules.foreground_interest: Include compelling foreground in landscapes for depth
composition_rules.fill_the_frame: Move close to subject; eliminate distracting backgrounds

camera_types.dslr: Digital Single-Lens Reflex; optical viewfinder; interchangeable lenses; workhorse
camera_types.mirrorless: No mirror; electronic viewfinder; smaller/lighter; latest technology
camera_types.film: Analog; different qualities of different film stocks; darkroom developing
camera_types.smartphone: Always with you; multi-lens; computational photography
camera_types.medium_format: Large sensor; extreme detail; professional fashion/commercial

lenses.focal_length: Determines field of view; measured in mm
lenses.wide_angle: Below 35mm; landscapes, architecture, tight spaces; distortion at edges
lenses.zoom_vs_prime: Zoom: versatile; Prime: sharper, faster aperture, forces creativity

light.golden_hour: First and last hour of sunlight; warm, soft, directional light
light.blue_hour: Just before sunrise/after sunset; cool, even, magical light
light.hard_light: Direct sun at midday; harsh shadows; dramatic
light.soft_light: Overcast sky; open shade; even, flattering

direction.back: Rim lighting; silhouettes; careful with exposure

color_temperature.white_balance: Camera or post-processing corrects for color temperature

post_processing.raw_vs_jpeg: RAW: all sensor data, edit in post; JPEG: processed in camera, smaller files
post_processing.workflow: Import → cull → rate → basic edits → color grade → export
